notes: Only the year is shipped: month is the 9th-character letter whose chart is image-only (Style-1_Argo-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png) and is not guessed; a later image pass can upgrade this style to year+month. Page also embeds an ECR brands-and-styles quick reference image (ECR-Brands-and-Serial-Number-Styles.png); no other ECR brand system is claimed from it here. Page lists sister or similar brands AIRCO, ARGO, Dunkirk, ECR, EMI, E-verter, Olsen, Oneida Royal, Pennco, RetroAire, Ultimate, Utica, but no shared-system claim is made for them.

styles.era: 9-character serials, 5 digits + dash + 2 digits + letter (year only shipped)
styles.notes: Page positions 7-8 = year digits (1-based, counting the dash as position 6); after normalization strips the dash, those digits sit at 0-based [5,7]. Month is the 9th-character letter, chart image-only, not shipped. Page example 21584-04B.
